svg.title: Chlorine residual control loop and the measured residual at two controller gains
svg.desc: Block diagram: the target is compared with the measured residual; the error drives a PI controller, which sets the hypochlorite dose rate; the dose mixes in the contact tank (25 minutes to the outlet) where raw-water demand acts as a disturbance; an analyser measures the residual every minute and feeds it back with a negative sign. Arrows carry signals, not material. Chart: after demand jumps at 06:00, gain 1 returns within ±0.05 mg/L by 07:00; gain 1.5 keeps oscillating, still ±0.11 mg/L at 16:00.
